Gabriel Gutierrez is a member of the Gavilan Joint Community College District Board of Trustees in California, representing Trustees Area 3. Gutierrez assumed office on December 9, 2022. Gutierrez's current term ends on December 11, 2026.
Gutierrez is running for re-election to the Gavilan Joint Community College District Board of Trustees to represent Trustees Area 3 in California. Gutierrez is on the ballot in the general election on November 3, 2026.
